name: Brookfield AI Campus – Strängnäs
overview: Brookfield Asset Management develops one of Europe's largest AI data center campuses in Strängnäs, Sweden, scaling from 300 MW to 750 MW IT load on 350,000 m². Powered by 100% renewable energy from Nordic hydropower grid.
summaryShort: 750 MW AI campus Strängnäs. Largest in Europe. SEK 95Mrd.

name: DC01UK Hertfordshire AI Hub
overview: DC01UK develops a £3.75Bn hyperscale AI and cloud campus in Hertfordshire, UK, receiving planning approval in 2025. One of Europe's largest planned AI hubs targeting hyperscale cloud and enterprise AI workloads with Tier III certification.
summaryShort: £3.75Mrd hyperscale AI hub Hertfordshire. Planning approved 2025.

name: Blackstone Aragon Data Center Campus
overview: Blackstone develops a €7.5Bn, 300 MW data center campus in Aragon, Spain, receiving Declaration of General Interest (DIGA). 150 MW power concession approved by Red Eléctrica. Campus runs on 100% renewable energy.
summaryShort: 300 MW €7.5Mrd Aragon. DIGA + Red Eléctrica concession obtained.
updates: 2024 Q4 – 150 MW Red Eléctrica concession approved.

name: Meta Talavera de la Reina Campus
overview: Meta Platforms constructs a 191-hectare data center campus in Talavera de la Reina, Castilla-La Mancha. €750M investment creates 250 direct jobs supporting Meta's European AI operations.
summaryShort: Meta €750M campus 191 ha Spain. 250 direct jobs.

contacts.title: Director of Data Center Development Europe

name: CyrusOne FRA7 Frankfurt Westside
overview: CyrusOne develops FRA7, 126 MW on 63,000 m² at Frankfurt Westside with BEOS AG and Swiss Life. E.ON adds 61 MW on-site power by 2029. 40 MW waste heat to district heating network.
summaryShort: 126 MW Frankfurt. E.ON power deal. 40 MW waste heat network.

name: Virtus Berlin Campus 1-4
overview: Virtus Data Centers builds 57.6 MW campus, four 14.4 MW buildings on 19,000 m². Partnership with DATA2HEAT supplies waste heat to 5,000 households. Tier III, PUE under 1.2, 100% renewable.
summaryShort: 57.6 MW Berlin campus. Tier III PUE<1.2. Heat for 5,000 homes.

name: Brookfield Data4 France AI Programme
overview: Brookfield commits €20Bn across France over five years. €15Bn led by Data4 for data center construction. Announced at Paris AI Action Summit February 2025.
summaryShort: €20Mrd France AI. Data4 leads €15Mrd DC construction programme.
updates: 2025 Q1 – €20Mrd announced at Paris AI Summit.

name: Digital Realty AMS11 Amsterdam
overview: Digital Realty launches its 12th data center in the Netherlands. AMS11 adds 27 MW on 12,000 m², bringing total Dutch capacity to 159 MW.
summaryShort: Digital Realty 12th DC Netherlands. 27 MW, 12,000 m².

name: Blackstone Northumberland AI Facility
overview: Blackstone plans Europe's largest AI data center in Northumberland with a £10Bn investment creating 4,000+ jobs, part of the UK National AI Strategy.
summaryShort: £10Mrd AI DC Northumberland. Europe's largest. 4,000 jobs.

name: Pure DC Westpoort Amsterdam
overview: Pure DC signs Europe's largest standalone hyperscale lease for a 78 MW campus in Westpoort, Amsterdam. Over €1Bn investment targeting hyperscale cloud providers.
summaryShort: Europe's largest standalone hyperscale lease 2025. 78 MW Amsterdam.
updates: 2025 – Largest standalone hyperscale lease signed in Europe.

name: HyperCo DAMAC Kouvola Finland
overview: HyperCo Oy (DAMAC Digital) develops €1Bn data center in Kouvola, Finland, part of TikTok Project Clover protecting data of 175 million European users. Powered by Finnish renewable energy.
summaryShort: €1Mrd Kouvola Finland. TikTok Project Clover €12Mrd EU data.
updates: 2024 Q1 – Announced as part of TikTok Project Clover.

name: Microsoft Spain AI Data Centers
overview: Microsoft invests $3.2Bn across three Spanish data center facilities adding 20,000 GPUs for Azure AI. Reinforces Spain as a strategic Southern European cloud hub.
summaryShort: $3.2Mrd 3 DC Spain. 20,000 GPU Azure AI expansion.
updates: 2025 Q1 – Construction commenced on all 3 sites.

name: Equinix PA10 Paris La Défense
overview: Equinix develops PA10, a new IBX in Paris La Défense adding 28 MW serving financial services and enterprise cloud customers.
summaryShort: Equinix PA10 Paris La Défense. 28 MW financial services hub.

name: Nscale Loughton Essex AI Campus
overview: Nscale invests £2.5Bn in AI data center campus in Loughton, Essex. $865M 10-year 40 MW colocation agreement signed with WhiteFiber NC-1.
summaryShort: £2.5Mrd AI campus Essex. WhiteFiber 40 MW $865M agreement.

name: Pantheon AI Atlas Croatia Campus
overview: Pantheon AI announces €50Bn AI data center campus Atlas in Croatia, potentially the largest DC investment ever announced globally targeting hyperscale AI training workloads.
summaryShort: €50Mrd Pantheon Atlas Croatia. Largest DC investment announced.

name: Nscale Portugal Porto AI Campus
overview: Nscale announces $812.6M AI data center campus in Portugal expanding Southern European AI GPU compute capacity for training and inference workloads.
summaryShort: $812M Nscale AI campus Porto Portugal. EU South AI expansion.

name: Kao Data Stockport Manchester
overview: Kao Data constructs £350M data center in Stockport, Greater Manchester serving cloud, AI and HPC. EPC contract awarded to ISG plc. Part of UK strategy to distribute DC capacity outside London.
summaryShort: £350M DC Stockport Manchester. Cloud AI HPC. ISG plc EPC.
updates: 2025 Q1 – EPC awarded to ISG plc.

name: Google Dublin Clonee Campus Expansion
overview: Google expands Clonee data center campus near Dublin with €1Bn+ investment to support growing European cloud demand. Ireland reinforced as Google's primary European data hub.
summaryShort: Google €1Mrd+ Dublin Clonee expansion. European cloud hub.

contacts.title: Head of Data Center Development EMEA

name: Amazon AWS Frankfurt Region Expansion
overview: Amazon Web Services invests €7.8Bn in Frankfurt cloud region expansion through 2029. Multiple new availability zones for European enterprise and AI workload demand.
summaryShort: AWS €7.8Mrd Frankfurt expansion 2024–2029. EU enterprise AI cloud.

name: Vantage Data Centers LON12 London
overview: Vantage Data Centers develops LON12 adding hyperscale colocation capacity in London market serving major cloud providers and enterprise customers requiring London-based infrastructure.
summaryShort: Vantage LON12 hyperscale London. Major cloud colocation expansion.

name: SAMCA Green IT Aragón Phase 1
overview: Phase 1 of SAMCA Green IT Aragón campus: construction of 131 MW Ribera Alta del Ebro data center on 408 ha with 43 km underground 220 kV transmission line and 220/30 kV substation.
summaryShort: 131 MW Phase 1 SAMCA Aragón. 43 km 220 kV line. Renewable.

name: Colt DCS London Hayes L5
overview: Colt Data Centre Services plans hyperscale data center campus in Hayes, London. 31.5 MW on 5,000 m², five 1,000 m² data halls. Part of Colt's Hayes data center campus committed to 100% renewable energy.
summaryShort: Colt L5 Hayes London. 31.5 MW 5 data halls. 100% renewable.

name: Verne Global Helsinki Campus Expansion
overview: Verne expands Helsinki campus for AI and HPC workloads up to 70 MW. Benefits from Finland's 100% renewable energy grid and low-latency Nordic connectivity.
summaryShort: Verne 70 MW Helsinki AI HPC. 100% renewable Nordic grid.

name: Digital Realty FRA20 Frankfurt
overview: Digital Realty FRA20 Frankfurt: 16 MW IT capacity, 8,100 m², two delivery phases. Part of Digital Realty's continued Frankfurt expansion strategy.
summaryShort: FRA20 Digital Realty 16 MW Frankfurt. 8,100 m² two phases.

name: Telehouse West London TW3
overview: Telehouse develops TW3 at West London campus adding 30 MW capacity for financial services and media companies adjacent to TW1 and TW2 with shared connectivity infrastructure.
summaryShort: Telehouse TW3 West London 30 MW. Finance media colocation.

name: G42 Microsoft AI Campus Abu Dhabi
overview: G42 and Microsoft develop a major AI cloud campus in Abu Dhabi following Microsoft's $1.5Bn strategic investment. Central to UAE AI ambitions providing GPU compute for regional AI services.
summaryShort: G42 Microsoft $1.5Mrd AI campus Abu Dhabi. UAE AI strategy.

name: Iron Mountain AMS1 Amsterdam
overview: Iron Mountain expands into Amsterdam colocation with AMS1 targeting European enterprise data management and compliance. Leverages existing records management customer relationships.
summaryShort: Iron Mountain AMS1 Amsterdam. Enterprise compliance colocation.

name: AtlasEdge Lisbon Campus
overview: AtlasEdge uses $292M sustainability-linked funding for two Lisbon data centers, benefiting from Portugal's green electricity grid and renewable infrastructure for carbon-neutral operations.
summaryShort: AtlasEdge $292M green Lisbon. 2 DCs 100% renewable Portugal.
updates: 2025 Q4 – Green finance secured and campus announced.

name: Apto Lacchiarella Milan Campus
overview: Apto develops Lacchiarella campus near Milan: €3Bn, 228,000 m², up to 5 data center buildings for AI and cloud. One of Italy's largest planned facilities.
summaryShort: €3Mrd 228,000 m² 5 DC Lacchiarella Milan. Italy largest planned.

name: Iozera Tetouan AI Data Center Morocco
overview: Iozera.AI plans 386 MW hyperscale AI data center at Eureka Park, Tetouan, Morocco. First major AI data center hub in North Africa targeting AI training workloads and digital transformation.
summaryShort: 386 MW Iozera AI hub Tetouan Morocco. First major AI DC Africa.

name: Microsoft Azure France Nord Expansion
overview: Microsoft invests €4Bn in French Azure data center expansion supporting AI cloud services for French and European enterprise customers as part of broader Brookfield France AI programme commitment.
summaryShort: Microsoft €4Mrd Azure France. AI cloud EU expansion.

name: AQ Compute AQ-BCN1 Barcelona
overview: Aquila Capital develops AQ-BCN1 data center in Cerdanyola del Vallès, Barcelona: 5 DC buildings, 60 MW total, 15 MW Phase 1 on 4.3 ha. LEED Gold, Net Zero Carbon certified. EPC awarded to GSE Group.
summaryShort: 60 MW AQ-BCN1 Barcelona. LEED Gold Net Zero. GSE Group EPC.
updates: 2024 Q2 – EPC awarded to GSE Group.
